name: Join an ongoing group conversation
short_description: Join an ongoing group conversation once under stated everyday conditions without assistance.
self_assessment: I can join an ongoing group conversation in one repeatable attempt without help.
description: Join an ongoing group conversation means carrying out this capability under ordinary, stated conditions without another person completing any part. Practice focuses on the observable result, the threshold in the self-assessment, and repeatability across more than one occasion. The capability includes selecting an appropriate approach, completing the action, and checking the outcome. It excludes brand-specific steps, credentials, unrelated habits, and one-off achievements.
examples: Join an ongoing group conversation in a fresh real-life scenario.
